content.title: Banks Power European Stocks to Record Highs
content.summary: European stocks finished Wednesday at fresh all-time highs, powered by the sector that was long the region's Achilles heel.  Banks are responsible for much of the year's 15% advance in the Stoxx Europe 600 and have extended gains after a strong batch of recent earnings.  The Stoxx Europe 600 sub-index tracking bank stocks is up 57% in 2025.
